text: Which statistical distribution do both DESeq2 and edgeR use to model RNA-seq read counts, accounting for the fact that counts are overdispersed relative to a simpler model?
explanation: Both DESeq2 and edgeR model counts using the negative binomial distribution, which adds a dispersion parameter to capture the fact that RNA-seq count variance exceeds the mean, unlike the Poisson distribution which assumes variance equals the mean. The Gaussian distribution is instead used downstream of a log-CPM transformation in limma-voom, and the beta-binomial distribution is not part of the standard DESeq2/edgeR modeling framework.
